title: Vehicle Performance Analysis
content: Vehicle-level delivery analysis should compare average delivery time, delivery speed, and delay rate across different vehicle types.

title: Outlier Detection
content: If average and median delivery times are close, the dataset likely contains fewer extreme outliers.

title: Delay Analysis
content: A high delay rate may indicate operational inefficiencies, traffic issues, or high delivery demand.

title: Peak Hour Analysis
content: Order volume and delivery performance should be analyzed across different order hours to identify peak demand periods.
